senses.gloss:
रिच् I. €7 U. (रिणाक्ति, रिङ्क्ते, रिक्त)
—1 To empty, evacuate, clear, purge; रिणच्मि जलधेस्तोयम् Bk. 6. 36;
 आविर्भूते शशिनि तमसा रिच्यमानेव रात्रिः V. 1. 8; तिमिररिच्यमानं
 पूर्वदिङ्मुखमालोकसुभगं दृश्यते V. 3.
—2 To deprive of, make destitute of.
—3 To separate, divide.
—4 To give or deliver up, part with.
—5 To bequeath (usually in p. p., see रिक्त). ━II. €1. €10 P. (रेचति,
 रेचयति, रेचित)
—1 To divide, separate, disjoin.
—2 To abandon, leave.
—3 To join, mix. ━Caus.
—1 To evacuate, make empty.
—2 To discharge, emit (as breath).
—3 To leave, abandon.
